name: Eurovision Classical Concerts
summary:
Eurovision Classical Concerts celebrates four talented and versatile ensembles that not only love and perform the classics of the repertoire to the highest standards, but commission and premiere the classics of the future, playing a unique part in moulding the musical landscape in Europe.

Featuring the world's oldest radio orchestra, the BBC Philharmonic Orchestra, WDR's Symphony Orchestra, Yle Finnish Radio Symphony Orchestra and RTP partner the Gulbenkian Orchestra, the series will tell their stories in a fresh and engaging way, intertwined with music that displays the orchestras' individuality and versatility, while shining a light on the cities and concert halls they perform in.

previousepisode.name: Helsinki: Finnish Radio Symphony Orchestra plays Sibelius's Finlandia

name: En nieu start
summary: Sivert Eimhjellen is a hopeless and homeless comedian living below the poverty line. Now Morten Ramm wants to help him get both his life and his career back on track.

name: I tjeneste for Norge
summary: A personal, unnerving and probing look at our own role in major, worldwide issues of war and peace, right and wrong, life and death.

name: Handcuffed: Last Pair Standing
summary: Could you survive being handcuffed to a total stranger 24/7? In a brand-new social experiment, Jonathan Ross challenges 18 brave Brits to stay together, as they compete to win £100,000.

name: Primetime in Milan: The Olympics
summary: Every night of the 2026 Milan Cortina Olympics, Primetime in Milan will showcase the biggest stars and most thrilling moments of the day's competition, with an emphasis on enhanced storytelling. Snoop Dog is returning to join Primetime in Milan most nights, giving a report after attending Olympic competitions or visiting with athletes and their friends and families. Stanley Tucci will also be on-site in northern Italy, spotlighting local cuisine, culture and lifestyle of the region.

name: Cyla Call Center
summary: Cyla Call Center In episodes that are sometimes funny and sometimes touching, the host and his guests take questions from callers, and the celebrities respond to the calls based on their own experiences, sensitivities, and personal perspectives, whether the questions are about dilemmas, family conflicts, workplace situations, life decisions, and taboo topics that are rarely discussed openly. The production is both entertaining and relatable, and the conversations are lighthearted and candid...

previousepisode.name: Náray Erika, Kovács Patrícia, Kamarás Iván, Járai Máté

name: Police Interceptors: Taking Down the Shoplifting Gangs
summary: Officers tackle the thieves terrorising supermarkets and shops, with organised international crime groups stealing eye-watering amounts in increasingly industrial, brazen and sophisticated ways.

name: Britain's X Files
summary:
Deep beneath the streets of London sit thousands of highly classified and previously top-secret government files which disclose the details of extensive military, spy agency and police investigations into the paranormal.

With hundreds of hours dedicated to examining these formerly off-limits documents from the National Archives, investigative journalist Tim Tate reveals just how far authorities on both sides of the Atlantic were willing to go to venture into the unknown.

Combining his findings with expert insight from Dr David Clarke, Britain's X-Files fact-checks out-of-this-world phenomena with cases including the legend of the Flying Dutchman, Harry Grindell Matthews and his Death Ray, the Beast of Bodmin, Uri Geller, the Comet plane catastrophes, premonitions on the Aberfan disaster and more.

name: Office Syndrome
summary: P33 is a real estate firm where office dynamics are intertwined with personal relationships. Pattamon, a formidable manager admired by executives, clashes with Pitarn, a well-liked manager. Little do their colleagues know, they were once in a romantic relationship. Proud, the owner's daughter, returns from abroad and hires Jimmy, a highly educated young man, but she spends more time shopping than working. Proud develops feelings for Jimmy, who, in turn, is interested in her friend Am. The office is filled with stories of other employees and their relationships.

name: Alexander Armstrong in India
summary: Alexander Armstrong embarks on an epic journey across India to explore how a nation that gained independence 77 years ago is now a rising global superpower.  With the world's largest population – 1.4 billion and counting - what do India's history, traditions, and people reveal about its rapid ascent?

name: Unconditional
summary: A mother-daughter vacation turns into a nightmare when 23-year-old Gali is arrested for drug smuggling in Moscow. Her mother, Orna, refuses to accept the charges — but her fight for Gali's freedom pulls her into a deadly web of crime and corruption.

name: Chasing Speed
summary: Enter NHRA's 330 MPH nitro world. Relive 2025 and Wally Parks' vision as the sport speeds toward its 75th anniversary.

name: Kitakata Kenzo Suikoden
summary: In a world where corruption is rampant and truth is crushed under an emperor indifferent to governance, a low-ranking government official, Sô Kô, quietly moves the wheels of destiny. Heeding the suffering of the people and wanting to save his nation, he creates a manifesto about justice and reform to aid those who have been trampled by unreasonable power. His loyal ally, Ro Chishin, travels the country to find like-minded comrades willing to rise up and take up this cause. This is a story of rebellion and reform, where the powerful and corrupt Song Regime as well as the secret organization "Seirenji" are the greatest obstacles.

name: Фортеця Маріуполь
summary: Film series built from the footage of video calls with the soldiers who were under encirclement at "Azovstal" in Mariupol. Since the beginning of the siege, the director has been having conversations with the "Azov" regiment fighters, thus creating their portraits. The most known episode is "Last Day At Azovstal" made in cooperation with soldier Dmytro «Orest» Kozatskyy.

name: Khalid Bin Al Walid: Sayf Allah Al Masloul
summary: This series chronicles the story of the Islamic leader Khalid Bin Al Walid as he grows up into one of the greatest leaders of the Islamic conquests.

name: Orange County Choppers Original
summary: Orange County Choppers Original brings the legendary shop back to its roots -- real bikes, real stories, and the raw, unfiltered energy that made OCC a household name.

name: Війна-ненажера
summary: A cycle of ten documentary-fiction adaptations of works by Ukrainian poets and writers who went to war.

name: Позиція Україна
summary: A series of twelve short documentaries about a day in the life of Ukrainian soldiers, volunteers, social service workers and ordinary Ukrainian citizens in the combat zone. The heroes live their everyday lives, doing their usual things. As a result, we have a historical chronicle that will shape our understanding of the present in years to come.

previousepisode.name: Під обстрілами возять хліб жителям прифронтового Курахового — подружжя Єршових

name: Uniformen
summary: When a police academy student shoots and injures an aggressive young man during a violent arrest, the investigation ensues as case raises serious questions about the use of force and training of the police.

name: X-Files
summary: Two highly decorated but vastly different FBI agents form an unlikely bond when they are assigned to a long-shuttered division devoted to cases involving unexplained phenomena.

name: Tian Du Yi Wen Lu
summary: Gifted with an exceptional talent for solving mysteries, the young prodigy Shi Wuming is invited to Tiandu City when a series of strange and violent cases shake the region. Together with Dali Temple official Su Xuelou, he delves into tangled clues and hidden motives. As the duo investigates deeper, they uncover layers of deception while navigating shifting alliances, moral dilemmas, and the complexities of justice in a turbulent city.

name: Игры и люди
summary: The project tells about spectacular victories and the most dramatic moments that happened to Soviet and Russian athletes at the Olympic Games. The series uses newsreels of tournaments, artistic reconstructions, and interviews with famous athletes and major sports figures.

name: За едой
summary: The presenters travel around the country to find out how agribusiness works in Russia. The audience will see promising startups, learn about technological processes and visit different parts of the country.

name: Мне изменили
summary: "They cheated on Me" is a reality experiment in which couples survived infidelity, saved their marriage, but did not return to happiness. Natalia Romanovskaya, a clinical psychologist, sexologist, and gestalt therapist, will help you open your feelings, regain trust, and restore intimacy.

name: Monster Trucks en tournée
summary: At the heart of the Monster Spectacular, Matthew Arel and his team juggle challenges, breakdowns, and fearless athletes.

name: The Box
summary: When a next door neighbor mysteriously dies one day, the next day a puzzling box has been placed in front of everyone's room. The innocent ones are blamed. Because the sender listed on the box is their dead neighbor, they each have to investigate who sent these boxes to everyone and what is inside each of them.

name: Lip-Reading The Royals: What Are They Really Saying?
summary: Experts reveal what members of the royal family are saying when they think nobody is listening, including whispered exchanges caught at weddings, funerals and state occasions.

name: Цезарь
summary: Gesha Korostylev works as a security guard in the regional administration and is raising a daughter with his wife, Lucy. He has endured ridicule from others all his life, because he has achieved nothing. Everything changes when Gesha finds out that his great-grandfather was Colonel Caesar. The fact that the stress falls on another syllable does not bother the guard, because he has already guessed that he is descended from the famous Roman commander. Gesha decides that the "descendant" of the legendary personality cannot live as before, so he leaves home, meets love in the person of businesswoman Cleopatra and finds a new vocation — to help the villagers.

name: Nippon Sangoku
summary: A revolution sparked by nuclear war, natural disaster, and misrule leads to the collapse of Japanese society. The country splits into three nations vying for hegemony, and the Sangoku era begins. Aoteru Misumi, a former agricultural officer, vows to reunify Japan. He rises through the ranks with only his knowledge and eloquence. Witness the legend of the man later hailed as a genius strategist.

name: Flower Boy
summary: When a cold-hearted, playboy Vice President sets out to save his collapsing company, he captures a beautiful young man from a rare flower tribe—an enchanting being whose natural fragrance mesmerizes everyone around him—to create a revolutionary perfume. But he soon discovers that the fragrance blooms most powerfully only in moments of true love. Determined to exploit this secret, the Vice President schemes to steal the young man's heart, unaware that behind the delicate beauty lies a poisonous thorn—one who harbors a calculated desire for revenge against those who destroyed his village, including the man he is beginning to fall for.

name: Song of the Samurai
summary: Song of the Samurai is a live-action adaptation that translates this deep legacy to the screen. Set in Kyoto at the end of the Edo period, the story depicts the intense and passionate lives of the Shinsengumi - the iconic samurai force that defended Kyoto in the final years of Japan's shogunate - through spectacular action and a bold interpretation based on historical facts. The story follows street brawler Toshizo Hijikata, who finds a new kind of family in Isami Kondo and Soji Okita. Hijikata and his comrades in the Shinsengumi forge a bond of loyalty - tested by betrayal, illness, and war - as they fight not only their enemies but their own ideals.

name: Un prophète
summary: Marseille, Present Day. Malik, a 17-year-old Comorian orphan is the sole survivor of a building collapse that housed an important drug deal. In the rubble, Malik is found with bags of cocaine planted on his body. He is directly sent to prison. Frail and illiterate, he must now find allies to ensure his survival in a grueling environment where clan hierarchy reigns supreme. Despite his precarious situation, Malik learns to navigate his way through the system. He gains power rapidly, and soon develops a taste for the inner workings of the criminal world.

name: Swindlers
summary: The stories of some of Ireland's most renowned con-artists and white collar criminals, told by their victims, friends and colleagues they deceived, journalists that covered the cases and the law enforcers who brought them to justice.

name: Reborn in 2000: Crush on My Deskmate
summary: Stricken with a terminal illness, Chen Fan gets a second chance at life when he is reborn in the year 2000. Reunited with Su Ruochu, his "first love", school beauty, desk mate who tragically died in a car accident in his previous life. He vows to rewrite their fate. Starting from nothing, he sets out to build a business empire, determined to give the girl he adores the perfect love and future they were robbed of.

name: Ross Kemp: Lost Boys, Deadly Men
summary: Ross Kemp: Lost Boys, Deadly Men blends true crime with an investigation into the crisis in masculinity affecting young men in Britain, emerging at a time when violence against women and girls has been declared a national emergency. While high-profile tragedies often spark public debate and political action, Ross questions the conclusions frequently drawn by the media and politicians about what drove those men to kill.

name: The Bonded Doctor
summary: Dr. Day is at a crossroads in life between her once clear dreams and her present exhausting reality. Just when she's on the verge of giving up, she receives a call from Dr. Ake, a doctor from the past who once devoted himself to providing medial care in remote areas.

name: Europe on the Edge with Katya Adler
summary: Aggression, ambition and allies. Western Europe has long played a central role on the global stage, but how will it confront the challenges of a turbulent new era?

name: Battle of the Brands
summary: Documentary pitting two similar companies against one another each week.

name: Як звучить світ... Україна
summary: How the world sounds... Ukraine is a completely new format, a musical journey. Musician and composer Yevgen Filatov (The Maneken, Onuka) collects the sounds of Ukrainian cities and creates a melody from them. And you watch it. This is an online demonstration of the magic of creating a composition from random sounds performed by Yevgen Filatov.

name: Bride Wars
summary: Set against the charming backdrop of North Carolina, Bride Wars follows a big-city wedding planner whose arrival in a small town sparks an epic showdown with a beloved local planner. As the two women battle to plan the same wedding, their rivalry quickly escalates into a larger clash over friendship, community, and, ultimately, love.

name: The Edge of Horizon
summary: As children, the "Little Prince" and the nursemaid's son were inseparable — their innocent first love blooming quietly within the palace walls. But their bond was torn apart by rigid traditions and the unyielding divide of rank and duty. Years later, they grow up in a kingdom on the brink of change. One has become a prince bound by responsibility and royal expectations, while the other longs for a life of freedom beyond the palace gates. When fate brings them face to face again amid a turbulent turning point in the nation's history, the feelings they once buried begin to bloom once more. But in a world ruled by hierarchy, honor, and unspoken rules, their love may be the one thing the kingdom cannot allow. Can love truly take root in a land where it is forbidden to exist?

name: Mon Merng Mang
summary: Kanfah, the grandson of a respected herbal doctor, travels to Wiang Asawa and becomes entangled in a political murder where a mysterious man named Thayu is falsely accused. After Thayu is poisoned by a venomous spider, Kanfah saves him, forcing the two to flee together through the dangerous highlands of Mueang Mang. As they uncover a conspiracy tied to the teak trade and local superstition, their partnership deepens into trust and quiet affection. Together, they must expose the real killer before the region descends into conflict.

name: Zhen Qian Jin De Yang Fu Mu Shi Shi You Da Wang
Lian Qi Lian Le San Qian Nian
Love in A Secret
summary: Ye Man, a calculating stepbrother, deliberately works his way into Lu Zhu's life. Meanwhile, her ruthless stepmother relentlessly strips away everything she holds dear, her reputation, her status, even her family ties, leaving her world on the verge of collapse. Yet the true twist lies in the unexpected. The strategist loses control and falls desperately in love with the very girl he once intended to scheme against. As ambition and desire collide, this forbidden love struggles to breathe in the shadows, uncertain whether it can ever step into the light.

name: Crazy Love, Moo-Moo!
summary: When the charming and charismatic Hia Fu tries to woo MooMoo, who longs for a normal life, Moo finds himself constantly surrounded by Fu's hilarious and mischievous antics. What tricks will this love-struck Hia Fu use to win MooMoo's heart?

name: Chasing Love, Chasing Cash
summary: Satang is a creditor who wants to open a cafe, and Job is the unlucky guy stuck with his ex's debt. When Satang realizes her new debtor is actually her favorite YouTuber who is also opening a coffee shop, she seizes the opportunity. She invests in his shop to pursue her own dream and to make sure he does not run away without paying.

name: Dynasty: The Murdochs
summary: Betrayal. Bitterness. Backstabbing. A real-life Shakespearean drama unfolds in this blow-by-blow account of the battle for Rupert Murdoch's empire.

name: Sangue & Mármore
summary: Sequeira, a major businessman in the finishes industry, is found dead near the Santo Inácio Zoo, in Avintes. On his body, two clues are discovered: a red fingernail and a photograph of a mysterious woman. Guedes, a private detective, is hired to solve the crime. Who is the mysterious woman? Where is the former Dragão Sandinense, Crespo? And most importantly, where is Sequeira's fortune?

name: Secret Stories: Roslin
summary: A troubled teen faces terror when her nightmare stalker becomes her family's charming houseguest. As her parents fall for his act, she fights to expose his true nature, leading to a startling revelation.

name: Bites of Promise
summary: The story of two close friends, with bitterness hidden in every promise... yet a sweetness remains that makes the heart tremble with every memory.

name: Tokeikan no Satsujin
summary: In 1989, a rookie editor visits a mysterious mansion for a séance, only for a psychic to vanish and a string of murders to begin. As a young mystery writer joins the investigation, dark secrets hidden in a cryptic poem left by the mansion's owner start to unravel.

name: The Witches Of Cambridge
summary: The Witches Of Cambridge follows two brilliant young women in 1950s Cambridge, Massachusetts, as they become immersed in a mysterious secret group of witches at Radcliffe known as the Lilith Society.

name: How A Peacock Burns Its Feathers
Don't Be Too Emotional
summary: Jane Patrick is a mysterious young man with a dangerously captivating charm who can make any wish come true, as long as you agree to a non-negotiable exchange. Because of that, no one dares get close to him. But Jane Jennalee, a handsome young football player, boldly approaches Jane Patrick to ask for his ball back without the slightest fear. That moment becomes the starting point of their connection. Friends constantly warn Jane Jennalee that Jane Patrick is dangerous, and he must never ask him for anything. However, Jane Jennalee feels that this man is actually gentle and kind. As their relationship deepens, Jennalee begins to see another side of him, leaving him unable to stop wondering who Jane Patrick truly is.

name: История его служанки
summary:
Moscow, 19th century. Lush balls, the glamour of estates, and behind-the-scenes intrigues. The young and eligible bachelor Count Nikolai Sheremetyev returns to the world of high society after the war. His arrival ignites the social circles, as mothers and daughters plot to secure a wealthy husband. However, things become more complicated for Nikolai, as his mother's will requires him to marry within a year, or he will lose his inheritance. Meanwhile, the Averin family finds themselves on the brink of ruin due to the family's gambling debts. Their daughter, Anna, a stubborn and witty noblewoman, decides to meet the count personally, hoping he will forgive their debt.

 Sheremetyev, a man of principles, offers a deal: a year of Anna's service at his estate. Thus, Anna becomes the count's most unusual servant. As she adjusts to her new role, various suitors arrive at Nikolai's home. However, the more time they spend together, the more difficult it becomes to conceal their mutual attraction. In the meantime, the stories unfold between Anna's younger brother, Roma, and the daughter of wealthy neighbors, Yulia, as well as between Elena and Averin, a couple whose marriage teeters on the brink of collapse but still holds a flickering spark.

name: Homebodies
summary: Homebodies follows Darcy a trans man who reluctantly returns to his regional hometown to care for his estranged mother Nora. But home isn't as he left it. Nora has been living with a secret housemate: Dee, the teenage ghost of Darcy's pre-transition self. As old wounds resurface, Darcy must confront the parts of himself he tried to leave behind or risk losing himself entirely.

name: Talons aiguilles et bottes de paille
The Adorable Family
summary: After giving birth, a highly accomplished professional finds herself overwhelmed by the realities of motherhood. Hoping to gain more care and understanding from her family, she pretends to have postpartum depression—but the lie backfires when two generations begin living together, throwing her life into chaos as she struggles to balance her career, relationships, and sense of self.

name: True Justice
summary: A law school student and her friends, set out to prove her brother's innocence but the only way to clear his name is by finding the real killer.

name: Поставь на рингтон
summary: How did the artists start their journey, what difficulties did they have to face, how did they overcome them, and what legacy did they leave? Why was Shura looked at as an alien? Why did the "Ranetki" banish the main participant? What kind of diagnosis almost put an end to Shura's career? And what did the producer of "Ranetok" do to save the drowning band? All this and more is in the "Put on a ringtone" project.

name: Где рождаются чемпионы
summary: Travel guide to the regions of Russia with the stars of Russian sports. The documentary project will show the unique places of the country and tell the stories of becoming champions. The film crew travels to different parts of Russia from North Ossetia to Kamchatka to show where the champions grew up. In four episodes, the program will tell about how St. Petersburg became the capital of basketball, what the childhood of the strongest wrestler was like, how the harsh climate brought up the famous skier and why North Ossetia is called "little Brazil".

name: Gene paniek
summary: Human interest series in which Philippe Geubels works as a fear coach and helps Flemish people overcome their fears.

previousepisode.name: Philippe confronteert Kaatje met een van haar grootste angsten

name: En Nu Is Ze Dood
summary: On average, a woman is murdered in our country every two weeks. Phara de Aguirre and Nahid Shaikh speak with relatives and victims of femicide.

name: The Ghost in the Shell
summary: Deep into the twenty-first century, the line between man and machine has been inexorably blurred as humans rely on the enhancement of mechanical implants and robots are upgraded with human tissue. In this rapidly converging landscape, cyborg superagent Major Motoko Kusanagi is charged to track down the craftiest and most dangerous terrorists and cybercriminals, including "ghost hackers" who are capable of exploiting the human/machine interface and reprogramming humans to become puppets to carry out the hackers' criminal ends. When Major Kusanagi tracks the cybertrail of one such master hacker, the Puppeteer, her quest leads her into a world beyond information and technology where the very nature of consciousness and the human soul are turned upside down.

previousepisode.name: Brain Drain III + Ghost Coast + Epilogue

name: Balance: A Perimenopause Journey
summary: Two monks confront perimenopause — and uncover the global health crisis every woman needs to know about.

name: Climax
summary: In a desperate attempt to revitalize his stagnant career, prosecutor Bang Tae Seop hatches an absurd but daring plan: take down the mayor of Seoul by exposing her corrupt ties to Lee Yang Mi, the head of the WR Group conglomerate. Tae Seop recruits Hwang Jeong Won to serve as an informant and manages to convince Kwon Jong Uk, a WR Group heir with his own grudge against Yang Mi, to join his cause. However, Tae Seop soon finds himself in a more complicated situation than he initially expected when he discovers that his wife Chu Sang Ah, a formerly loved actress, may be hiding dangerous secrets from him.

name: Unexpectedly Naughty Fukami
summary: Akihiro Kaji, a popular "ace" from the sales department at his company, is seen as admirable by his co-workers, but he is secretly a narcissistic playboy who looks down on others, giving them scores based on their attractiveness. One day, Kaji is paired with Yu Fukami on a business trip. Despite Kaji finding him sloppy and disshevled at first, he becomes drawn to after discovering he is sexually attractive.

name: Shitsuren Karuta
summary: The protagonists of the story are Chinami Natsuno, Hikaru Baji, and Ayase Noda, who met through a university club. The trio, who spent their evenings drinking and playing board games, each harboured their own complicated romantic troubles. Now aged 27, Chinami and her friends begin to reconsider matters of romance, love, and marriage. After witnessing their friend Misaki flee a wedding ceremony they attended, they are compelled to confront their own romantic issues.

name: My Stepbrother Is My Favorite Novelist!?
summary: Kei is a virgin novelist with zero dating experience. And yet, his next work is BL!? Suddenly, Kei's devilish stepbrother, Kairi, appears before him. His seemingly experienced brother will teach him the thrills of romance, but...

name: Mordufer
summary: "Mordufer" is set in the border triangle on the northern shore of Lake Constance and combines the investigative work of the criminal investigation department and customs. The story centers on two dissimilar women: Doro Beitinger, in her early 40s, returns to her job after several years of caring for her family, children, and sick mother. Her new boss at the police department, Chiara Locatelli, is in her late 20s, ambitious, and comes from an Italian family background. Two women from different generations, with different lifestyles, who quickly realize that they work perfectly together as a team and can even solve seemingly unsolvable cases. Due to the border location, the two regularly work with their colleagues from customs, represented by customs officer Florian Jäger and senior customs inspector Nico Arnold.

name: Century Plant: We're Partners, Friends, and Sometimes Lovers
summary: Century Plant: We're Partners, Friends, and Sometimes Lovers (センプラ 相方が親友で時どき恋人) is a Japanese BL vertical drama. There are 30 short episodes in total. The story is adapted from a manga by Jiro Kawaii (河飯じろう).

name: Hostage
summary: The rise of a violent rogue state and the journalists who disappeared. Loyalty and coercion collide in Islamic State Group's chilling kidnap of James Foley and John Cantlie.

name: Hunting Bundy: Chase For The Devil
summary: Detectives unite across states to capture serial killer Ted Bundy, unveiled via new crime scene photos and intense police interviews.

name: The Hidden World of Snakes
summary:
Across millennia, snakes have captivated human imagination, feared as omens of danger yet revered as symbols of rebirth, transformation and renewal. Today, more than 4,000 species of these extraordinary reptiles share our planet, playing a vital role in maintaining ecological balance by controlling rodent populations.

Equipped with remarkable sensory systems and some of the most potent venoms in nature, evolution has honed each snake into a masterful predator. From scorching deserts to lush rainforests, see how these creatures have adapted to thrive in every corner of the planet and uncover the hidden world of snakes.

name: Besos robados
summary: At the prestigious art institute Ars Viva, the new teacher Alejandro faces a classroom of rebellious girls, led by Paloma, who becomes his biggest challenge and secret love interest.

name: Демократизация народов
summary: In this film, authors, experts and those who have just experienced the processes of democratization will try to figure out together why good intentions often turn into abuse and chaos, whether universal values are so universal and how they combine or not with the national mentality of different peoples.

name: Тайна красных виноградников
summary: A project that reveals the secrets of one of Van Gogh's main masterpieces, "Red Vineyards in Arles." The documentary series is dedicated to the work of studying and preserving the painting.

name: Doctor Shin
summary: Top actress Momo is preparing to marry Ju Shin, the accomplished director of a neurosurgery hospital who seems to have everything. But a sudden accident leaves her body intact while her brain is fatally damaged, plunging her into a coma. Faced with the devastating possibility of losing the woman he loves, genius neurosurgeon Ju Shin makes a desperate decision and ventures into forbidden medical territory. In a final attempt to save her, he performs an unprecedented "brain change" surgery, transferring another soul into Momo's body. When she opens her eyes again, the soul within her is no longer the woman he once loved. If another soul inhabits the body of the person you love, can that love remain the same? A forbidden choice made to save love unfolds into an unforeseen fate and devastating consequences.

name: Cabbage Your Life
summary: Seong Tae Hun, a high-ranking executive, is suddenly reassigned to the rural village of Yeonri-ri with his family. Unprepared for country life, Cho Mi Ryeo struggles as farming and housework prove harder than expected. Meanwhile, their eldest son, Seong Ji Cheon, once bound for medical school, begins to discover himself. However, village chief Im Ju Hyeong grows wary of the family, who arrived with a major corporation. As they endure rural life while longing to return, can they find their way back?

name: Bedaine
summary: A broken former superhero, Bedaine tries to find meaning in his life in his hometown. Between wacky enemies, deep wounds, and lost wings, he will discover that there are other ways to be a hero.

name: Bole UP
summary: Bole UP is a flagship infotainment program produced by Doordarshan Kendra Lucknow for the DD Uttar Pradesh network. The show blends interviews with audience participation and cultural showcases, featuring spotlights from regional talents.

name: Blue Therapy
summary: Seven couples move out of their comfort zones and onto the therapist's couch to try and work through their relationship issues in this reality series.

name: En ven, en morder
summary: In this documentary, three friends recount their memories of a series of crimes that changed their lives and rocked their quiet corner of rural Denmark.

name: Piekło Kobiet
summary: Set in pre-WWII Poland, this drama series follows a woman's fight for justice for victims of sexual assault – and her own autonomy.

name: Hello Bachhon
summary: A physics teacher sets out to make quality education accessible to all students through online learning. Based on a true story.

name: El Asesino de TikTok
summary: A missing woman's family discovers that one of the last people to see her was a peculiar content creator — who was convicted of homicide years ago.

name: Pardon the Intrusion, I'm Home!
summary: Rinko, a quiet office worker and secret otaku, just wants to enjoy her anime in peace. But when a neighbor keeps banging on the wall, she asks her other neighbor, Satsuki, for help. Their attempt to resolve the issue goes wrong, leaving a hole in the wall that reveals…Usaharu-sensei, the creator of Rinko's favorite manga?! Now with nowhere to hide, their lives begin to overlap in surprising ways!

name: Vanvidsbilisterne
summary: Crazy drivers kill innocent people on Danish roads every year. To combat life-threatening behavior in traffic, the police have been given a new tool: the insanity clause. With it in hand, the police now have the opportunity to punish Denmark's most dangerous drivers much more severely than before. Unconditional revocation of the driver's license, confiscation of the vehicle and imprisonment await road users who commit the worst offences.

name: Vejens Helte
summary: We follow the professional rescuers from Viking roadside assistance – the previously overlooked heroes who head out when accidents and mishaps occur in traffic.

name: Mord auf dem Inka-Pfad
summary: The mysterious murder of a German tourist in the Peruvian Andes in 1997 sparks one of the most difficult and extensive investigations in German criminal history. As a tenacious seeker of the truth, Munich detective Nina Gummich embarks on a grueling mission that takes her across three continents and to her personal limits over the course of years. Based on a story by Rolf Basedow, the screenplay for this four-part crime series was written by Mika Kallwass and Nina Wolfrum.

name: Britain's Almost Perfect Murders
summary: Britain's Almost Perfect Murders follows expert-led, forensic investigations of cases where meticulous, near-flawless crimes were ultimately uncovered due to tiny, overlooked fatal mistakes by the perpetrators.

name: Snowball Earth
summary: Yukio was destroyed in battle and Tetsuo survived in an escape pod. After eight years in cold sleep, the escape pod finally lands back on Earth. But when Tetsuo emerges he finds a world in ruins, entirely frozen beneath a blanket of ice and snow—snowball Earth! What happened to humanity, how did the planet freeze over, and will Tetsuo be able to keep his last promise to Yukio?

name: Killed Again, Mr. Detective
summary: Sakuya Otsuki is the son of a legendary detective, working to follow in his father's footsteps with his assistant, Lilithea. However, something's different about this high-school sleuth. Wherever he goes, he always manages to get himself entangled in his cases—as a murder victim! When Sakuya is tasked to infiltrate a luxury cruise ship, he finds himself killed once again. But every time he reopens his eyes, Lilithea is there by his side, ready to help him get to the bottom of the mystery...

name: The Regression of Great Sage Riddle
summary: A young man named Riddle had lost all of his friends—and the entire world—at the hands of a mysterious organization known as the "Box of Malice." Having lost all hope to live, he dwelled in a pit of despair until he has one final revelation. What if... he could return to a time before everything ended? And so, after a thousand years, a deformed Riddle finally manages to reverse time. "I'm going to stop them this time...!" Equipped with a thousand years of knowledge and experience in his young body, the Great Sage Riddle's journey to the past now unfolds!

name: Beyond the Brush
summary:
Beyond the Brush takes viewers on a journey through the ages of art, exploring the evolution of creativity across centuries. 

Each episode uncovers hidden secrets, personal struggles, and the cultural shifts that shaped history's greatest masterpieces. From the brushstrokes of genius to the untold stories behind the canvas, this series will reveal how every work of art holds far more than meets the eye.

name: Juliet & Juliet
summary: When heirs of two feuding families become one another's first love, will it end in love or tragedy?

name: You're Only Young Twice
summary: You're Only Young Twice centers on Emily and Alex, who got pregnant and married in high school but now they're 35 and their kid is starting college. That means they can get divorced and start life all over again while they're still young enough to enjoy it. Newly divorced empty-nesters, they stumble through dating, co-parenting, and maybe a second chance at love.

name: Line of Fire
summary: When a U.S. Marshal falls in the line of duty, a seemingly cut-and-dry case turns into a deadly conspiracy as a family of law enforcement agents become the target of a mysterious assassin. Bridging personal differences and crossing professional boundaries, the Hollingsworth family must use the expertise from a lifetime of protecting civilians and politicians to protect one another and bring the killer to justice... even if it means betraying their sworn code.

name: Rivals
summary: In Rivals, a series exclusive to Kayo Sports, some of the best rugby league players in the world will go head-to-head with their counterparts from Aussie Rules and Rugby Union to decide which code deserves bragging rights.

name: Хоспис
summary: It seems that there is no place for failures in the life of cardiac surgeon Viktor Sturm, but the ideal facade is cracking due to problems in his personal life: Victoria's 14-year-old daughter loses trust in her father when he refuses to take on a hopeless patient. Trying to return his daughter's love, Sturm loses control, disrupts the operation and finds himself outside the profession. Trying to cope with a turning point in his career, a world-class doctor unexpectedly finds himself in a hospice, where his first wife and former classmate are dying. Trying to help her, Sturm gets a job at an institution as an orderly and, under the supervision of a local doctor, Maria Pichugina, nicknamed Birdie, begins the journey from a cynic to a man who is not afraid of death.

name: Слепой
summary: Having received a tip on a rich house, Senya, who trades in small-scale criminal earnings, goes on a robbery. But he is caught by the owner, a very influential and eccentric businessman, Orlov, who also turns out to be blind. Suddenly, he doesn't turn him in to the police, but makes him his personal assistant. But the seemingly carefree life of a billionaire turns into a tough business struggle for Senya with a high-ranking official, where not only their own destinies, but also the lives of their loved ones are at stake.

name: Bize Bi'şey Olmaz
summary: Aktan and Lal, at an unexpected point in their lives, encounter a love they cannot control, and despite all their differences, they cannot resist each other.

previousepisode.name: Aşk Dediğin İman Etmektir Bir İmkansıza

name: Goat Girl
summary:
Tarzan was raised by apes. Mowgli was raised by wolves. Gigi was raised by… goats.

This is the story of Gigi, a 13–year-old girl who just happens to have been raised by mountain goats. But now that she's a teenager, her Nanny and Billy think it's time that she spread her wings (er… horns?), so this year she will attend a boarding school and, for the first time in her life, spend time around actual people. Goat Girl is about being comfortable in your own skin, about being happy being you, about embracing your differences and your quirks – and even your weirdness!

name: Magic Move
summary: When an architecture student in his final year accidentally becomes a famous university fortune teller, he pretend-reveals that he was the childhood ship partner of the young heir to a real estate fortune. Although their relationship begins with a lie, it develops into a genuine love. At the same time, a young man fresh off a failed attempt to become a star in Korea comes back in search of his once-ship partner—who happens to be a particular real estate heir.

name: The Warrior Princess and the Barbaric King
summary: Serafina, the West's fiercest knight, expected torture when captured by barbarians. Instead, she got a marriage proposal! Marrying her sworn enemy is a hard no! But after seeing her wedding captor's culture and very pretty face, she may be tempted to swap her sword for a wedding veil. Get ready for the ultimate enemies-to-maybe-lovers arc.

name: 2 for 2000
summary: On the run-up to the new millennium, CBBC launches its biggest ever game show. Hosted by heptathlete Denise Lewis, with Steve Wilson and Rachael Hopper.

name: Tigre-kun to Vanadi-chu
summary: Short chibi specials streamed alongside with the Madan no Ou to Vanadis anime TV series. Each episode was available on the official web site, and were later included on DVD/Blu-ray release.

name: Born to Bowl
summary:
Born to Bowl takes viewers inside the colorful world of professional bowling, chronicling five stars of the sport – Kyle Troup, Anthony Simonsen, EJ Tackett, Cameron Crowe, and Jason Belmonte – as they chase glory, respect, and much-needed prize money on the Professional Bowlers Association (PBA) Tour.

Set within bowling's blue‑collar culture, the series examines a familiar American family pastime that evokes myriad pop cultural references and reveals a quirky sport with ancient roots shaped as much by personality and persistence as by skill and precision. Every season, members of the PBA Tour travel from tournament to tournament with their balls in tow, fighting for victories from Akron to Reno, often needing to share budget hotel rooms along the way. At different stages of their careers, each man balances their ambition and love of the sport with the uncertainty of a profession built on week‑to‑week performance and earnings that often require them to take day jobs to make a living.

name: Kusunoki's Garden of Gods
summary: Minato Kusunoki is assigned to manage his family's haunted, abandoned countryside estate. However, thanks to his overwhelming spiritual power, Minato accidentally purifies the entire place, turning the once-cursed property into a peaceful haven for wandering gods and deities! As Minato settles in, he finds himself surrounded by quirky divine neighbors and the lively chaos of life among the gods.

name: Release that Witch
summary: Roland, a modern man reborn as a prince in the dangerous Border Town, rescues the witches Anna and Nana Pine from the Church. Harnessing their extraordinary powers, he fuses magic and technology to craft weapons, armies, and steam engines to defend his people. As the Demon Moon rises and conspiracies close in on his family, Roland must lead a revolution to protect his allies and reshape the world.

name: Life Is Strange
summary: Life is Strange follows Max, a photography student, who discovers she can rewind time while saving the life of her childhood best friend, Chloe. As she struggles to understand this new skill, the pair investigate the mysterious disappearance of a fellow student, uncovering a dark side to their town that will ultimately force them to make an impossible life or death choice that will impact them forever.

name: Risk Lust Love
summary: A story of greed, lust and capriciousness, of people who don't consider the consequences of their actions until it's too late. Priao is young and spoiled with role-model parents. She's an unrepentant partier but she's faithful. Aon has grown up with the weight of her parent's hopes on her shoulders. They want to see her elevated in society with a wealthy, appropriate partner. One looks wicked, another looks put-together and sweet, just as she would have it.

name: Ru Guo Qin Jian Hui Shuo Hua
Treasure Island
summary: Treasure Island charts the transformation of teenager Jim Hawkins from sheltered boy to emboldened young pirate. When Jim gets his hands on a legendary treasure map, his mother Bess' clever and decisive actions leave him holding valuable knowledge that puts both of their lives in danger.

name: Where There's Smoke
summary: In Where There's Smoke, a group of firefighters will navigate the intense challenges of their profession while grappling with personal struggles, fractured relationships, and the emotional toll of saving lives in a world filled with danger, drama, and heartbreak.

name: Leon – Glaub nicht alles, was du siehst
LAUGH
summary: Bigg Jah's dark comedy anthology explores the dangerous, absurd moments of Los Angeles hood life where survival often depends on bad decisions.

name: Yi Wan Quan Zhou Zhi Jiang Mu Ya
Bling Bling
summary: A small likay troupe is facing a major crisis. Following the sudden passing of the troupe's founder, his eldest son Petch-thae, unprepared, must step up as troupe leader and guide the family's likay troupe through all the troubles rushing in, all while endeavouring to preserve the vanishing traditional artform.

name: The Mask of Love
summary: Boon is an elder craftsman of ghost masks, which are said to be vessels for the dead. After dreaming of his missing daughter, Lalita, calling for help in the forest, he's unaware when her spirit enters his latest piece. When travel content creator Thianphisut visits the Phi Ta Khon ghost festival in Loei with her boyfriend Rachen, she purchases Uncle Boon's blue mask and is possessed by Lalita's spirit. In this new form, Lalita meets her former lover Chatban, and he feels an uncanny familiarity.

name: Saneha Stories 4: Saiyai Saneha
summary: Tako has a son with Bell, and he's discovering he may be gay.

name: Jenny A.M./P.M.
summary: Jenkhwan, an architecture freshman who loves competition, loses a bet with his good friend Pod. Consequently, Jenkhwan has to dress as a woman for their high school farewell party. By chance, Jenkhwan comes to save drunk comm arts freshy Pin. Jenkhwan likes her immediately but the two part ways before they can get to know one another. Fate, however, brings them together again under confusing circumstances: Jenkhwan's name ends up on the girls' dorm list and his roommate is none other than Pin. At first, Jenkhwan intends to clear things up and have his name moved to the men's dorm list. Then Pod proposes a new wager; as his rival, he thinks Jenkhwan has no chance of successfully hitting on Pin. As someone who never surrenders, Jenkhwan's next move is to become Jenny and take up his place in the women's dorm.

name: Kirio Fan Club
summary: Aimi and Nami, two best friends who are rivals in their intense, sometimes delusional obsession with their quiet, average classmate, Ken Kirio. The story focuses on their over-the-top fantasies and attempts to grab his attention while they navigate high school life.

name: Sôgen no shôjô Laura
summary: Laura, the Prairie Girl is a Japanese anime television series based on the novels Little House in the Big Woods and Little House on the Prairie by Laura Ingalls Wilder. Twenty-six half-hour episodes were released between 1975 and 1976.

name: Dao Yao Xing
summary: Forced into a marriage of convenience based on mutual benefit, Jiang Yuan, an assassin from the Tai Xuan Tower, and Shao Yue, the holy maiden of the Jiu Xuan Sect, are ordered to marry. On their wedding night, they attempt an assassination, only to discover they are both immortal. To obtain the Demon-Suppressing Bell and the Demon-Controlling Bell, secret treasures of each other's sects, they transform from mortal enemies into a facade of marriage, engaging in a charade of mutual deception.

name: Hunt for the Missing: Chicago
summary: Retired Chicago Detective Pamela Childs revisits unsolved missing persons cases as she hopes to uncover new leads and find potential answers for the victims' families.

name: Naked City: Hitmen
summary: Carl Williams' thirst for revenge ignites Australia's bloodiest underworld war. To dominate the drug trade, he enlists a team of misfits to eliminate all rivals. Enter, the hitmen.

name: Maison de retraite, la série
summary: Christophe Beaugrand is now part of the tour of the new series "Maison de Retraite". The actress Chantal Ladesou was part of the casting. Six episodes on each other in box and diffusion are scheduled to debut in 2026 on TF1.

previousepisode.name: La crise de la double quarantaine

name: NÜKTE
summary: The story revolves around 35-year-old gambler Daniyar. Having escaped the trap of gambling addiction and returned home from a rehabilitation center, he carries the heavy burden of the past: lost joy, inexhaustible debts, years that have wounded his soul. Now he is faced with the task of rekindling his son's faith, starting a new life, and finding himself again. On this journey, he meets a love that warms his heart and restores his faith in miracles. This series is a story about second chances and self-acceptance, reminding us that everyone deserves a new beginning.

name: Drapet på LastebilJonas
summary: The family and friends of Jonas Aarseth Henriksen are left in despair after the murder that shook Norway. New details and the full story provide more answers to what happened.

name: Reclaiming My Lost Love
summary: Xu Chuyuan had secretly loved Bo Yanzhou for years. Their marriage was arranged, but all she received from him was cold indifference. When her identity as the "fake heiress" is exposed, she believes she has become nothing more than an unwanted daughter in a wealthy family and leaves in heartbreak, unaware that she is carrying twins. Unbeknownst to her, Bo Yanzhou's mother secretly takes away their baby boy, deepening the misunderstanding between them. Six years later, fate brings them together again. This time, Bo Yanzhou returns with their son, determined to win Xu Chuyuan back. When the truth finally comes to light, he fights with everything he has to reclaim the love he once lost.

name: Twisted Yoga
summary: Twisted Yoga follows a group of young yoga students from around the world drawn to the ancient practice in search of inner peace and purpose, only to fall under the influence of reclusive Romanian "guru" Gregorian Bivolaru, the spiritual leader of an international network of yoga studios specializing in tantric rituals. As they begin to fear they've joined a cult, they discover that Bivolaru, who often summoned select female students to his Paris apartment for private initiations, has a dark past. Bivolaru now faces charges in France, including human trafficking, kidnapping and rape — allegations he denies — as these women work with French authorities to convict him.

name: Mao Shan Zai Zai Kai Ju Shou Fu Lao Zu Zong
Filing for Love
summary: Ki-jun, once the ace of the internal audit team, is now stuck handling petty office scandals—all thanks to his manager, In-ah. One day, he receives an anonymous tip: In-ah is involved in an inappropriate relationship at work. Digging into her secret for revenge, Ki-jun instead finds himself drawn to her.

name: We Are All Trying Here
summary: An aspiring director hits rock bottom after 20 years chasing his debut — until he meets an overwhelmed producer who helps him rediscover his self-worth.

name: The New Gothic
summary: The New Gothic redefines the legendary storytelling of the American South as it follows the collision of the enterprising Bloom family with the resurrected Mississippi Mafia. Set in a landscape stained by red clay and bad blood, villainy is commonplace. But power is singular.

name: 12 негритят
summary: 12 негритят is a show about people, a project that the characters themselves make. 12 people learn to live together, make friends, fall in love, quarrel and make up, build relationships.

name: Pen Tor 2017
summary: Yom and Wok compete for a girl's attention but she is more interested in Pentor. They become angry and plot a vengeful plan to get even.

name: Pen Tor 2018
summary: Pen Tor is about modern working singles who are looking for partners. It is centered around Mr. Pentor, a businessman in the BKL company. He wants to have an easy life and just wants to be a normal businessman like other people in Bangkok.

name: Remember
summary: A young lawyer with an extraordinary memory confronts the hurdles of proving his father's innocence in the face of serious criminal accusations.

name: The Messenger
summary: Q, the god of love who lost confidence in love, asked to leave heaven and go to the human world to find the "answer to love". In such an era where it is easy to love and break up, when he met Design, Q finally changed his opinion about love, which he had firmly believed in for 200 years.

name: My Royal Nemesis
summary: A Joseon-era villain doomed to die opens her eyes in modern-day Seoul — where a ruthless chaebol heir may be her last chance to rewrite her fate.

name: The Cat and the Dragon
summary: An orphan since hatched, a lone dragon named "Uncle Wings" is taken in by a family of magic-wielding cats and raised as one of their own. As Uncle Wings grows, he becomes the cats' protector, determined to keep them safe from humans. But as he watches the cats connect with humans using their magic, Uncle Wings slowly starts to warm up to humans in this heartfelt, bittersweet tale.

previousepisode.name: The Cat and the Royal Capital Festival

name: Ingoku Danchi: Deviant's Apartment Complex
summary:
Rookie building manager Yoshida must protect the peace of the apartment complex from the threat of a perverted housewife !

Yoshida, who took over as the caretaker of a certain housing complex in place of his father, is met with attacks from married women who have descended into madness while wearing lewd outfits called "Libido Cross."
While being tossed about by the rampage of residents such as Watanabe and Ichinose, the threat of A-list married woman Kanzaki and the shadow of the police interfering with the incidents further deepen the darkness of the housing complex.
Yoshida confronts them with his weapon, the "Boltack Claw," but behind him lies the sinister hand of the even greater despair, the "Vanishing Exclusionary Women's Association."

previousepisode.name: The Superhero of Justice in Battle!

name: Fake Fact Lips
summary: Ryou and Zen are two men who hate to lose—especially to each other. From high school rivals to rival co-workers, these two men have always been locked in fierce competition. They've competed over grades, sports, and even the number of Valentine's chocolates received! And now that they're salesmen at the same company, their rivalry has reignited. One night, while out for drinks, the two begin arguing about who's more experienced in love. Suddenly, their newest competition is set: the winner is whoever makes the other fall in love with them first! But will this competition of hearts really lead to a win or something far more complicated?

name: Alexander
summary: In Alexander, as the Athenian empire crumbles, the world's greatest mind, Aristotle, arrives in Macedonia to tutor a volatile young prince Alexander. Amid palace intrigue, forbidden love, brutal war and ruthless ambitions, their unlikely friendship shapes an empire and alters the course of history.

name: Avvocato Ligas
summary: Lawyer Lorenzo Ligas is the man everyone would like to be. He is fired from his prestigious law firm because he is unable to distinguish between duty and pleasure, and to get back to the top he will face a challenge that he cannot tackle alone.

name: Do You Like Big Girls?
summary:
Sota is suddenly made the dorm manager and coach of the Kitaei University women's volleyball team by a single word from his older sister, Kaoru .

There, he finds his first love, Ayano, and experiences a fateful reunion... but
in the girls' dorm! In the gym! In the hotel!?
What awaits him are days of being tossed around by girls who are bigger than him!

A hilarious harem romantic comedy with a huge size difference is born in the northern lands!!

name: The Galloping Heart
summary: With a vivid and lively gallery of characters, this drama unfolds four warm and healing stories set in xizang. There is a vibrant xizang's grandma, a xizang's cuisine team stepping onto the global stage, an indomitable young plateau marathon runner, and a brave and pure blind girl. They meet and illuminate each other atop the plateau, just as a line from the drama goes: "In the scenery we pass by, lie the lives of others; encounters from afar are also a reunion after a long separation."

name: Reincarnated Love
summary: Jiang Ruoli, the legitimate daughter of the Prime Minister's mansion, has the gift of precognition. When she dreams that her parents will be killed on the Lantern Festival, she tries to change their fate, only to be drawn into a dark conspiracy. She then meets Huo Linchuan, the heir to the Duke's mansion, who hides the mystery of ten lifetimes of reincarnation. Using his memories from past lives, Huo Linchuan saves Jiang Ruoli many times. Starting as allies, the two slowly fall in love. Through family power struggles, tangled secrets, and misunderstandings, they stand together against the hidden villain. Transcending cycles of reincarnation, they finally break the curse and stay by each other's side for eternity.

name: Great British Castle Rescue
summary:
Great British Castle Rescue follows Rick Edwards as he ventures inside some of the UK's most spectacular and endangered castles. 

From crumbling medieval towers to collapsing royal chambers, engineers and historians battle to stabilise these epic structures with help from National Lottery funding. Each rescue unlocks extraordinary stories of warrior kings, civil wars, brutal betrayals and forgotten lives. 

Across each episode, Rick meets heritage experts, engineers and stonemasons racing to save these buildings. Blending cutting-edge engineering, adventure and vivid historical reconstruction, the series reveals how these fortresses shaped Britain, and whether they can survive for future generations. Castles featured are Fyvie, Gwyrch and Lowther.

name: Corazón de Oro
summary:
Luz lives a modest life with her daughter Catalina, who is ashamed of her humble origins and pretends to be wealthy while dreaming of a life of luxury. Miguel Ángel, a successful blind lawyer, struggles to earn the approval of his powerful father, the owner of the prestigious Arango-Nova vineyards.

Years ago, a scandal at the estate tore Luz and Miguel Ángel apart, cutting short a love that never truly faded. An unexpected reunion forces Luz to return to the vineyards with Catalina, reopening old wounds and bringing long-buried secrets to light.

As Luz confronts lingering feelings, Catalina, blinded by ambition, pushes herself to dangerous extremes. Amid betrayal and sacrifice, mother and daughter become entangled in a battle where love and ambition put everything at risk.

name: Peaky Blinders: The Immortal Man Podcast
summary: Creators, special guests and stars — including Cillian Murphy — unpack the "Peaky Blinders" saga in this official companion podcast for the new film.

name: The Strongest Job is Apparently Not a Hero or a Sage, but an Appraiser (provisional)!
summary: Hibiki Manabe is transported to a world where monsters roam freely. There, he's granted a skill, "Appraisal," and given the job title, "Appraiser (Provisional)." With the help of Emalia, an elf from the grassland plains, he becomes an adventurer and teams up with Claude, Lilian, and Vene. Will he ever make it home? And will he become the strongest?!

name: Monster Aliens
summary: In Monster Aliens, chilling encounters blur the line between UFO sightings and legendary beasts. From Bigfoot to owl-men, witnesses and experts uncover a global pattern that suggests monsters and extra-terrestrials may be one terrifying mystery.

name: Even a Replica Can Fall in Love
summary: Nao is a replica created to be Sunao Aikawa's perfect double, stepping in whenever Sunao skips school. She studies, plays sports, and lives each day for the original—until one day, Nao falls in love. Suddenly, her quiet, borrowed life blooms with secret dates and shy promises. But the more she cherishes them, the more she must hide from Sunao, who's starting to notice the changes in her replica.

name: Haibara's Teenage New Game+
summary: Natsuki Haibara thought his high school years were a complete failure—until he suddenly wakes up as a freshman again, armed with all he learned in college. Determined to rewrite his school days, he joins the popular crowd, makes friends he never had, and grows closer to his crush. But second chances aren't as easy as hitting "Restart." Can Natsuki turn his regrets into a rainbow-colored youth?!

name: Мёртвая точка
summary: Rita Galich, a housing lawyer, works at a social center. One day, she receives the news that her father, a respected lawyer and university lecturer Evgeny Vladimirovich, is accused of murdering his graduate student. Evgeny Vladimirovich's guilt is obvious to everyone — he was detained at the scene of the crime, his fingerprints were found on the murder weapon and on the victim's body. But Rita does not believe that her father was involved in what happened, and wants to find out the truth on her own.

name: Yétili
summary: Join Nina and Leon, two little mice, at story time with Yetili. Every day Yetili reads them an amazing new story. Yetili is a giant plush toy and mascot of the local bookstore. When the store is closed, he comes to life to join his friends for story time. And where can you find this magical shop? Why, it's right next door. Come in and have a look.

previousepisode.name: Attention, il y a un loup dans ce livre !

name: Ernest et Rebecca
summary: Ernest et Rebecca follows the adventures of a six-and-a-half-year-old girl named Rebecca and her best friend, a microbe named Ernest, whom she catches on a rainy day. Together, they navigate daily life, school, and crazy adventures while Ernest serves as the ultimate remedy for bad moods.

name: h&p@bbc.
summary: New variety show presented by comedy duo Hale and Pace. Weekly items include well-known names battling it out in Celebrity Quiz, unlikely impersonations of famous musical acts in Stars with Smoke in Their Eyes, and a search for Britain's most generous towns.

name: Skate Tales
summary: Skateboarder Madars Apse travels the world to skate with and learn from people pushing the culture of skateboarding in their own special way.

name: Kenny's World
summary: Follow Australia's favourite portaloo plumber and part-time philosopher on a sight seeing tour you won't find in any travel guide

name: The Bob Morrison Show
summary: The Bob Morrison Show is the story of an ordinary family from through the eyes of their pet dog, Bob Morrison. Bob is an adorable stray that is welcomed by the youngest member of the Morrison clan, Ben, but he has a tough time winning over the rest of the family.

name: House Gang
summary: When Mike, a bankrupt landlord, and his adolescent daughter Chloe suddenly find themselves homeless, they decide the only solution is to move in with their three tenants. But father and daughter are shocked to learn that they now share a house with three people with an intellectual disability, and a motorbike-mad social educator. And if Chloe has something to say about the situation, so do Robert, Trev, Belinda and Jack. A warring comedy of foiled expectations follows.

name: Shinda Ani no Shinyuu wo Hiroimashita
summary: Taku Chiga (An Togashi), a first-year high school student living in Nasu Town, Tochigi Prefecture, one day happens to witness a young man, Mitsuru Morimoto (Mirai Fukahori), about to jump off a bridge and instinctively stops him. When Taku talks to Mitsuru after he regains his senses, it seems Mitsuru has nowhere to go and no money. Though suspicious, Taku couldn't bring himself to think Mitsuru was a bad person and reluctantly allowed him to stay for just one night. However, it later transpires that Mitsuru was the best friend of Suga's late elder brother, Harumi (Yoshida Haruto). Why has his brother's friend appeared now? What is his true identity? And what is the secret behind the sketchbook clutched in Mitsuru's hand—?

name: Wishing Upon the Shooting Stars
summary: A legend spreads on Xingpu Islet: toss a stone into the sea, and your wish may come true. He Xiangyong, a young man beaten down by life, makes a desperate wish to disappear. The next day, he wakes as Zhong Xiaoyou. No one knows him except his best friend Wanzhe, who stays by his side. Little by little, his new life brings warmth. He reconnects with his father, with everyone. Then Haowei returns, haunted by his own wounds. He's an old friend, a secret crush, and he can't explain why Xiaoyou feels so familiar. Meanwhile, Wanzhe wishes for epic love under shooting stars, sparking a chase by fisher Xiaohai. But Wanzhe is torn between sweet gestures and unsure feelings.As feelings deepen, Haowei and Xiaoyou's relationship grows painful, strained by their secret. Wanzhe and Xiaohai's bond is torn between true feelings and a mere wish. When shooting stars return, truths surface, confessions wait, and choices press in. Everyone must pay the price: memories fade, identities slip, love hangs in the balance. In the end, they face one final choice: hold onto the miracle, or let it go. Fate is waiting.

name: Predator Files
summary: Predator Files takes viewers onto the front lines of the fight to apprehend the world's most dangerous online child predators. Led by Roo Powell, law-enforcement consultant, survivor advocate, and founder of SOSA (Safe From Online Sexual Abuse), the series documents high-stakes undercover operations conducted in direct partnership with ICAC task forces, vice units, and district attorneys across the United States.

name: Stripped Down
summary: When six gay strippers at a Florida gay strip club are asked to live together, tensions boil as they navigate interpersonal conflicts and struggles in the industry.

name: I Became a Legend after My 10 Year-Long Last Stand.
summary: With no other options, Luck makes the choice to hold the line against the unending demonic hordes alone, to make sure his comrades can escape with their lives. However, through a combination of fortune, skill, and ingenuity, he holds that line for ten straight years, eventually coming out on top singlehandedly. Now he has to tackle the dilemma of how to occupy himself in a world where he holds a myriad of roles: that of a legend, that of a veteran, and that of a brand new face.

previousepisode.name: Leave the Next 10 Years and Beyond to Me Too

name: Space Warrior Baldios
summary: After polluting their own planet beyond repair, a race of evil aliens target earth as their next home. Now it is up to a lone outcast and his robotic spacecraft, Baldios, to defend earth. But, first he must convince the distrusting human population of the impending danger.

name: Bear Grylls Is Running Wild
summary: Bear Grylls Is Running Wild follows legendary adventurer Bear Grylls as he takes some of the most famous people on the planet into the wild for a 48-hour journey of a lifetime. With thrilling action and revealing conversations, Bear takes his guests on unforgettable adventures in breath-taking wilderness and reveals a side of some of your favorite people like you've never seen before. This season, Bear Grylls leads cast members on a globe-spanning adventure through some of the planet's most unforgiving landscapes — from Norway's glacial wilderness to the legendary mountains of Eryri in Wales. The journeys cut through Arctic rainforest, vast canyonlands, and brutal desert terrain, pushing participants to their limits with glacier crossings, canyon descents, high-risk extractions, and an adrenaline-charged freefall from 11,000 feet, into an adventure along the Irish Sea.

name: The Jack Dee Show
summary: Mean, moody, miserable and magnificently funny, Jack Dee takes to the stage at the Bohemia Club with an assortment of music guests.

name: Planes That Changed History
summary: Dive into the 125 years of aviation to uncover how aircraft have reshaped our world. The series explores the engineering secrets behind its success, its humble origins, and what made these aircraft icons years after their initial success.

name: La Oficina
summary: Jerónimo Ponce III, regional manager of Olimpo Soaps, is a nightmare for his employees, who must endure his politically incorrect outbursts just to survive the workday.

name: Mira: Her Şey Yolundaymış Gibi
summary: When her husband drops the bombshell that he wants a divorce, Mira sets out to rebuild her life on her own terms.

name: Power Couple România – La bine şi la greu
summary: Power Couple Romania is a reality TV competition that tests the resilience, trust and physical limits of celebrity couples.

name: Без кутюр
summary: A project about fashion, style, and beauty with Alexey Sukharev! Using Russian and Western showbiz stars as examples, we highlight five fashion trends of the season. We'll show you all the successful and unsuccessful examples of how celebrities have embraced these trends, with a fashion expert commenting on them. We'll also tell you what to bring back from your mom's or grandma's closet to stay on trend. And in our columns, you'll learn how much Russian stars' looks cost and how their style has evolved over the years.

summary: Mini-Jon and Mini-Maple are undergoing their training in the most secretive and technologically advanced Agency in the world! It's like school, but with less boredom and more explosions

summary: When upper class English girl Penelope Townes finds a magic opal that contains two Australian genies, Bruce and his son Baz, she thinks all her problems are over. Bruce, however, has other ideas.

name: BOHO
summary: Kima loses her job and pursues a crazy idea. Nawal struggles with her desire to have children. Alex thinks the Flemish have it too easy. Three friends from Borgerhout search for happiness and stumble through life happily.

name: Garfield
summary: Garfield, the series, is inspired by Jim Davis' original comic strip and features the chonky feline at his finest, most sarcastic and lackadaisical.

name: Agent from Above
summary:
Agent from Above follows Han Chieh, a spirit medium bound to serve the Third Crown Prince to atone for a childhood mistake by resolving supernatural disturbances in the human world. Along the way, he meets the optimistic college student Yeh Tzu and detective Chang Min, who can see spirits. 
Together, they face deadly confrontations with the mysterious and ruthless villain Chen Chi-sha, while uncovering the truth behind Chen Wu Tien-chi, a being threatening the balance between the human and demon realms — leading Han Chieh to rediscover his purpose and the true meaning of his gift.
